meta.offset_sign: + = left of travel from our finished_centerline; edges are lateral offsets from the line
meta.platform: run of 0.5 m ground bins with no step above 12 cm between neighbours (24 pct), the one containing or nearest the line
meta.carriageway: inside the platform, the nearest run of >=4 m of bins with median intensity < 900 (gaps <=1 m closed); the whole platform when none
meta.earlier_fit: crossfall.lidar.json [ground [tilt %, sd m, points], deck], raw_used_pct, composed_pct (the file build_mesh reads)
